about: Misuse/correct pairs for the most-imported non-@solid-primitives packages of the 38-app corpus, at the versions those apps install with Solid 2.0.0-rc.9. Read by misuse-runtime-ledger.mjs --cases. Each pair differs only in where the package's reactive value is read.

excluded.reason: imports solid-js/store, a Solid 1.x entry point that solid-js 2.0.0-rc.9 does not export; the package cannot load under Solid 2, so no misuse/correct pair can run
